abstract: Cultured mouse blastocysts produce plasminogen activator, a protease that converts the zymogen plasminogen into the trypsin-like enzyme, plasmin. We have fractionated the blastocyst and cultured the constituent cell types. Trophoblast outgrowths free of inner cell mass derivatives secrete plasminogen activator during a time period that closely parallels the invasive phase of trophoblast cells in utero. Isolated inner cell masses also produce plasminogen activator; further fractionation of the inner cell mass as well as studies with primary cultures obtained from midgestation tissues demonstrate that enzyme formation is restricted entirely to parietal endoderm cells. Secretion of the enzyme may facilitate the migration of parietal endoderm cells along the trophoblast layer as the yolk sac cavity enlarges during gestation. F9 embryonal carcinoma cells do not secrete detectable amounts of plasminogen activator. However, when these cells are induced to differentiate, the resulting parietal endoderm-like cells are capable of producing the enzyme. These results are consistent with previous findings suggesting that plasminogen activator production may be a characteristic of invasive and/or migratory cells.
abstract_ja: 培養マウス胚盤胞はプラスミノーゲンアクチベーターを産生する。胚盤胞を分画して構成細胞型を培養した。内細胞塊の派生細胞を含まない栄養膜の外植片は、子宮内における栄養膜細胞の浸潤期とほぼ平行して本酵素を分泌した。内細胞塊の単離体も本酵素を産生し、さらに分画と妊娠中期組織の初代培養により、酵素産生は壁側内胚葉細胞に限られることが示された。本酵素の分泌は、妊娠中に卵黄嚢腔が拡大する際に、壁側内胚葉細胞が栄養膜に沿って移動することを助ける可能性がある。F9胎児性癌細胞は検出可能な量の本酵素を分泌しなかったが、分化誘導すると、生じた壁側内胚葉様細胞は本酵素を産生できた。これらの結果は、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーター産生が浸潤性および/または遊走性細胞の特徴であるという考えと一致する。
